Elements are a shared property of various [[Spells]], [[Basic Attacks]], [[Weapons]], and a few [[Weathers]], that determine certain interactions.
{{TOC limit|2}}

==Overview==
Elements interact with [[Status Effects]], [[Tiles]], [[Passives]], [[Items]], [[Unit Types]], and [[Enemies]].

Some tiles and types of [[Weather]] can apply persistent versions of the elements.<br>
These persistent elements are constantly applying their effects instead of the usual one-off check.

Some units or units with certain status effects apply the element to all tiles they make contact with. Internally referred to as "Innate Element"
<!--Just look at the categories-->

Immunity to an element not only blocks elemental damage but also prevents any [[status effects]] from being inflicted from the same effect.<br>
Status effects that have an element cannot be applied to a unit with the matching immunity. 

An item or ability may have any number of elements.<br>
Elements are indicated in the top-left corner for abilities and middle-right for items, and are displayed following a priority order:<br>{{el|Electric}}, {{el|Fire}}, {{el|Ice}}, {{el|Water}}, {{el|Grass}}, {{el|Earth}}, {{el|Wind}}, {{el|Holy}}, {{el|Explosion}}, {{el|Gravity}}, {{el|Music}}.

{{Clear}}

== Electric ==
[[File:Element Electric Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* {{el|Electric|nolink=y}} conducts through tiles with {{el|Water}} and units with {{st|Wet}} or {{st|Metal}}.
** This causes the full effect of the action to be applied to all entities and tiles in the conduction area, potentially turning an ability targeting a single target into a large area of effect, depending on the conditions.
* {{Type|Robot}} units are immune to Electric and will become {{st|Energized}} when affected by electric, which gives them an extra turn. <!-- this is not governed by the robot tag, but the Robot passive -->
** Instead of an extra turn, electric damage applies a different buff to the following units and objects:
*** {{en|Tesla Coil|Tesla Coils}} gain {{st|Magic Damage Up|#=1}} instead.
*** {{obj|Decoy|Decoys}} and {{obj|Rubber Fist Bot|Rubber Fist Bots}} do not have any effects when energized.
*** {{obj|Slot Machine|Slot Machines}} are guaranteed to have a jackpot.

=== Notes ===
* {{el|Electric|nolink=y}} is not directly tied to {{st|Stun}}.
** Immunity to {{el|Electric}} does not grant immunity to Stun.
Of the 18 abilities with {{el|Electric|nolink=y}} in the game, 9 are {{class|Mage}} abilities, 6 are {{class|Tinkerer}}, 2 are {{class|Collarless}}, and 1 is a {{class|Fighter}} ability. 13 have a chance to {{st|Stun|nolink=y}}.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Electric element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Electric element items]]
* {{st|Elite Buff: Static|Static}} elites.

* {{we|Thunderstorm}} and {{we|Blizzard}} have a 50% chance of a lightning strike occuring after each turn.

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Electric adds increasing {{st|Stun}} chance to the cat's basic attack.
* {{p|Lightning Aspect}}: Grants Electric immunity and grants {{st|Charge|#=+1}} when dealing Electric damage.
* {{p|Lightning Rod}}: Grants Electric immunity, grants {{st|Charge|#=+1|nolink=y}} when hit by Electric damage, and increases Electric damage by +1.
** {{+}}: Grants {{st|Charge|#=+1|nolink=y}} for each point of damage blocked and increases Electric damage by +2 instead of +1.
* {{p|Conductor}}: Increases Electric damage by +2 for each piece of {{st|Metal}} armor worn.
* {{p|IT'S ALIVE!}}: Causes Electric damage to revive dead units with {{st|Charmed}} and {{st|Doomed|#=1}}. The doomed unit will not get injured.
* {{i|Technology}}: Taking Electric damage refreshes use.
* {{i|Conductor}}: Increases Electric damage by 1 and adds a 10% chance to {{st|Stun|nolink=y}}
* {{i|Frank Bolts}}: Grants Electric immunity and revive if hit by Electric damage when [[downed]].
* {{mut|Eyes.336}} Grants Electric to Basic Attacks and adds a 5% chance to {{st|Stun|nolink=y}}. 
* {{mut|Ears.754}}: Increases Electric damage by 1.
* {{mut|Ears.339}}: Grants Electric immunity.

==== Negative ====
* The following units are immune to {{el|Electric|nolink=y}}:
** Nearly every single {{Type|Robot}} unit, with the exception of {{En|Rover|Rovers}}. Do not rely on electric damage if you plan to go to {{Chapter|The Future}}.

==== Other ====
* [[AI|AI-controlled]] units will prioritize hitting allied robots with Electric.
* Conduction: Turns any {{el|Electric|nolink=y}} effect into an area of effect. Notable examples:
** {{el|Ice}}: {{st|Freeze}} large {{el|Water}} areas.
** {{el|Electric|nolink=y}} basic attack:
*** {{cl|Cleric}} [[Basic Attacks]]: Heal all allies and damage all enemies. 
*** {{i|Magic Seed}} / {{p|Thorn Arrows}}: Convert connected {{tile|Water|nolink=y}} to {{tile|Bramble}}.
*** {{i|Glowing Seed}}: Convert connected {{tile|Water|nolink=y}} to {{tile|Tall Grass}}.
* {{a|Number One}} / {{i|Rain Staff}}: Indirect synergy by creating areas of {{tile|Water|Water Tiles|nolink=y}}.

{{Clear}}

== Fire ==
[[File:Element Fire Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
==== Keywords ====
* Removes {{st|Wet}}. 
** This also prevents any {{st|Burn}} from being applied by the Fire element effect.
* Removes {{st|Freeze}}
** {{el|Fire}} damage can damage {{st|Freeze|Frozen}} units.
* Converts all stacks of {{st|Tarred}} on a unit into {{st|Burn|nolink=y}}.
* Removes all stacks of {{st|Entangled}} or {{st|Webbed}}.
* Destroys {{st|Flammable}} items, inflicting {{st|Burn|#=+1|nolink=y}} per equipped Flammable item.

==== Tiles ====
* Converts various tiles into {{Tile|Fire|Fire Tiles}}.
** Affected tiles: {{tile|Grass}} / {{tile|Tall Grass}} / {{tile|Flower}} / {{tile|Tall Flower}} / {{tile|Bramble}} / {{tile|Thick Bramble}} / {{tile|Web}} / {{tile|Tar}}.
* Replaces {{Tile|Ice|Ice Tiles}} and its variants with {{Tile|Water|Water Tiles}}.

==== Other ====
* Cooks food-type [[pickups]]. e.g; {{obj|Food}} becomes {{obj|Cooked Food}}.
* Burns {{obj|Catnip}}, making all adjacent units gain the full {{stat|Mana}} it would've otherwise provided to a unit.
* Causes {{Type|Bomb}} units to immediately detonate. <!-- this is not governed by the bomb tag, but the BombBehavior passive -->
* Causes {{Type|Plant}} units to be inflicted with {{st|Burn|#=+3|nolink=y}}. <!-- this is not governed by the plant tag, but the Plant passive -->

=== Notes ===
* {{el|Fire}} does not innately apply {{st|Burn}} or create {{tile|Fire}} on empty tiles.
** But immunity to {{el|Fire}} does provide immunity to {{st|Burn}}. 
* Units which are innately {{el|Fire}}, do not cook {{obj|Food}} or burn {{obj|Catnip}} which they walk over.

Of the 26 {{el|Fire|nolink=y}} abilities in the game, 9 are {{class|Mage}}, 5 are {{class|Tinkerer}}, 4 are {{class|Butcher}}, 3 are {{class|Collarless}}, 2 are {{class|Fighter}}, and the remaining 3 belong to {{class|Psychic}}, {{class|Druid}}, and {{class|Hunter}}. 21 inflict {{st|Burn|nolink=y}}.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Fire element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Fire element items]]
<!--Persistant-->
* {{weather|Firestorm}} weather applies persistent {{el|Fire|nolink=y}}.
<!--Innate-->
* The following units apply {{el|Fire}} to tiles they contact.
** Units with {{st|Burn}}
** Elites with {{st|Elite Buff: Flaming|Flaming}}
** {{obj|Hot Rock}}
** {{obj|Hot Boulder}}
** {{mb|Abandoned One (Head)}}
** Cats with the {{set|Molten}}
** Cats with {{p|Fire Aspect}}

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Fire adds an increasing amount of {{st|Burn|nolink=y}} to the cat's basic attack.
* {{p|Fire Aspect}}: Grants Fire immunity; Fire element damage is increased by 1 and inflicts {{st|Burn|#=+1|nolink=y}}.
** {{+}} Increases damage by 2 and inflicts {{st|Burn|#=+3|nolink=y}}.
* {{i|Ember}}: Fire element damage is increased by 1 and inflicts {{st|Burn|#=+1|nolink=y}}.
* {{i|Pyrophina's Toenail}}, {{Set|Molten}}: Grants Fire immunity.
* {{i|Scorched Earth}}: Reduces the {{icon|Mana Cost}} of Fire element spells by 1.
* {{el|Fire|nolink=y}} + {{st|Cleave}}: If a food pickup would spawn, cooked food is spawned instead.

==== Negative ====
* The following units are immune to {{el|Fire}}:
** Elites with {{st|Elite Buff: Flaming|Flaming}}.
** {{mb|Cerberubs}}
** {{en|Brute}}
** {{en|Belcher}}
** {{en|Chain Demon}}
** {{en|Cloaked Demon}}
** {{en|Hot Poker}}
** Notably, {{b|Tormentor}} is ''not'' immune. <!-- this is not governed by the demon tag, tormentor is not immune to fire -->

{{Clear}}

== Ice ==
[[File:Element Ice Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* {{el|Ice|nolink=y}} inflicts {{st|Freeze}} on {{el|Water}} units / units with {{st|Wet}}.
* Ice converts {{Tile|Water|Water tiles}} into {{Tile|Ice|Ice tiles}}. 
** Units frozen in {{tile|Water|Water}} gain {{st|Freeze|#=+1|nolink=y}} for each water tile they occupy. 
* Ice converts various plant-based tiles into {{Tile|Ice Spikes|Ice Spikes tiles}}.
** Affected tiles: {{tile|Grass}} / {{tile|Tall Grass}} / {{tile|Flower}} / {{tile|Tall Flower}} / {{tile|Bramble}} / {{tile|Web}}

=== Notes ===
* {{element|Ice}} is not directly tied to {{st|Slow}}.
** Immunity to {{element|Ice}} does not grant immunity to {{st|Slow}}.
Of the 12 Ice abilities in the game, 9 are {{class|Mage}} abilities, and the remaining 3 belong to {{class|Collarless}}, {{class|Fighter}}, and {{class|Psychic}}. 3 apply both Freeze and Slow, 4 only apply Freeze, and 4 only apply Slow.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Ice element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Ice element items]]
<!--Persistant-->
* {{weather|Snow}} and {{weather|Blizzard}} apply {{el|Ice}} persistently.
<!--Innate-->
* The following units apply {{el|Ice}} to tiles they contact.
** {{st|Freeze|Frozen}} units.
** Cats with {{p|Ice Aspect}}.
** Cats with {{i|Ring of Frost}}
** {{obj|Ice Cube}}

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Ice adds an increasing amount of {{st|Slow}} to the cat's basic attack.
* {{p|Ice Aspect}}: Grants the ability to damage frozen units and immunity to Ice.
* {{i|Liquid Nitrogen}}: Increases ice damage by 2.
* {{mut|Head.753}}, {{mut|Legs.315}}, {{mut|Mouth.755}}: Grants immunity to Ice.

{{Clear}}

== Water ==
[[File:Element Water Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* Inflicts {{st|Wet}} on units.
* Removes all {{st|Burn}} from the unit.
** This still applies {{st|Wet}}.
* Douses {{Tile|Fire|Fire}}.
* Cools {{Tile|Lava|Lava tiles}} into {{tile|Basalt|Basalt tiles}}
* Grows {{Tile|Grass|Grass}} and {{Tile|Flower|Flower}} to grow into their tall variants
* Grows {{Tile|Bramble|Brambles}} into {{Tile|Thick Bramble|Thick Brambles}}.
* Water damage heals {{Type|Plant}} units by an amount equal to the damage that would have been dealt.

=== Notes ===
Of the 13 {{el|Water}} abilities in the game, 7 are {{class|Collarless}} abilities, 3 are {{class|Mage}}, 2 are {{class|Druid}}, and 1 is {{class|Cleric}}.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Water element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Water element items]]

* The following weathers apply {{el|Water}} persistently:
** {{weather|Rain}}
** {{weather|Heavy Rain}}
** {{weather|Thunderstorm}}
** {{weather|Flash Flood}}
** {{weather|Hurricane!}}

* The following units apply {{el|Water}} to tiles they contact.
** {{mb|Flushmaster}}.
** {{st|Wet}} units.

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* Extinguishes {{obj|Coven Candle|Coven Candles}}.
* Negates {{st|Heat Wave}}.
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Water adds an increasing area of water tiles to be spawned at the target of the cat's basic attack.
* Water indirectly triggers the following effects by inflicting {{st|Wet}}:
** {{p|Like a Fish}}: {{icon|Holy Shield|#=1}} at the end of turn if no holy shield is present.
** {{Mut|Ears.325}}: {{st|Charge|#=1}} & {{icon|Shield|#=1}} at the end of turn.
** {{i|Rain Hat}} {{Mut|Legs.758}}, {{Mut|Legs.759}}: {{st|All Stats Up|#=1}}.
** {{mut|Ears.752}}: {{st|Damage Up|#=2}}
** {{mut|Mouth.323}}: {{st|Health Regen|#=2}}
** {{mut|Ears.302}}, {{mut|Texture.301}}: {{st|Health Regen|#=1}} & 1 Mana Regen.
** {{mut|Eyes.339}}, {{mut|Mouth.319}}: {{st|Health Regen|#=1}}.
** {{mut|Ears.318}}: {{st|Brace|#=1}}.
** {{mut|Head.308}} {{mut|Legs.300}}: +1 movement range.

==== Negative ====
* {{en|Parasaurolophus}} always crits against units with {{st|Wet}}.
* Certain Items become {{st|Brittle}} and/or {{st|Fragile}} while their equipped cat is {{st|Wet}}.

==== Other ====
* {{st|Wet}} units are {{st|Freeze|Frozen}} by {{el|Ice}}.
* {{st|Wet}} units conduct {{el|Electric}} damage.

{{Clear}}

== Grass ==
[[File:Element Grass Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* {{el|Grass}} grows {{tile|Grass|short Grass}} on {{tile|Empty|empty tiles}}.

=== Notes ===
Of the 7 {{el|Grass}} abilities in the game, 4 are {{class|Druid}} abilities, 2 are {{class|Hunter}}, and 1 is {{class|Collarless}}.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Grass element abilities]]
<!--* [[:Category:Grass element items]]-->
* The following units apply {{el|Grass}} to tiles they contact.
** {{type|Plant}} units

* {{el|Grass}} is applied to units standing on one of the following tiles, though this has no effect:
** {{tile|Grass}}, {{tile|Tall Grass}}
** {{tile|Flower}}, {{tile|Tall Flower}}
** {{tile|Bramble}}, {{tile|Thick Bramble}}

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Grass adds an increasing amount of {{st|Poison}} to the cat's basic attack.
* {{a|Control Plants}}: Attacks all units on Grass element tiles.

==== Negative ====
* {{type|Plant}}: Immune to {{el|Grass}} attacks. <!--Damage and Healing-->

{{Clear}}

== Earth ==
[[File:Element Earth Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* {{el|Earth}} replaces non-earth tiles with {{Tile|Dirt|Dirt Tiles}}.
** {{tile|Stalagmite}}, {{tile|Basalt}}, and {{tile|Lava}} will not be replaced.

=== Notes ===
* Of the 9 {{el|Earth}} abilities, 8 are {{class|Tank}} abilities and 1 is a {{class|Jester}} ability. 6 create {{obj|Small Rock|Rocks}}, and 2 apply {{st|Petrify}}.
* {{el|Earth}} does not innately create {{obj|Small Rock|Rocks}}.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Earth element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Earth element items]]
* The following units apply {{el|Earth}} to tiles they contact.
** {{en|Wooly Mammoth}}
** {{mb|Bumblefoot}}
** Cats with {{p|Mountain Form}}.

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Earth adds an increasing chance to {{st|Petrify}} to the cat's basic attack.
* {{i|Scorched Earth}}: Reduces the mana cost of earth element spells by 1.

==== Other ====
* {{a|Aftershock|+}} makes all of a cat's spells have the earth element.

{{Clear}}

== Wind ==
[[File:Element Wind Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* Effects with {{el|Wind}} are always directional. 
* Pushes units in the winds direction.
* Spread {{Tile|Fire|Fire tiles}} in the winds direction.
* Applies {{st|Burn|#=+1}} to units with {{st|Burn}}
* Turns {{tile|Water|Water tiles}} into {{tile|Water Current|Water Current tiles}}, with the current going in the winds direction.
* Removes {{tile|Dirt|Dirt Tiles}}, inflicting {{st|Blind|#=1}} to units on top of them.
* Cuts down Tall {{tile|Tall Grass|Grass}} / {{tile|Tall Flower|Flower}} tiles into their short version.

=== Notes ===
Of the 18 {{el|Wind}} abilities in the game, 4 are {{class|Druid}} abilities, 4 are {{class|Butcher}}, 3 are {{class|Mage}}, 2 are {{class|Collarless}}, 2 are {{class|Monk}}, and the remaining 3 belong to {{class|Fighter}}, {{class|Tank}}, and {{class|Thief}}.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Wind element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Wind element items]]
* {{en|Twister|Twisters}} spawned by the {{Weather|Tornadoes}} weather apply {{el|Wind}}.
* The following weathers apply {{el|Wind}} each round:
** {{weather|Windy}}
** {{weather|Thunderstorm}}
** {{weather|Blizzard}}.
** {{weather|Hurricane!}}.

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Wind adds an increasing amount of knockback to the cat's basic attack.
* Extinguishes {{obj|Coven Candle|Coven Candles}}.

{{Clear}}

== Holy ==
[[File:Element Holy Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* Holy {{icon|healing}} will instead deal damage to {{Type|Zombie}} units, units with {{st|Zombie}}, or otherwise [[undead]] units. 
* Holy effects are unable to damage {{Type|Angel}} units, instead applying {{st|All Stats Up|#=1}}. <!--Immunity to damage, but any effect gives them that-->
* Converts {{obj|Poisoned Food}} and its variants into their {{obj|Purified Food}} counterparts.

=== Notes ===
Of the 42 {{el|Holy}} abilities in the game, 35 are {{class|Cleric}} abilities, 4 are {{class|Collarless}}, 2 are {{class|Mage}}, and 1 is a {{class|Druid}} ability.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Holy element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Holy element items]]
* {{we|Blessed Day}} applies {{el|Holy}} persistently.

=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Blessing of Holy Fire}}: Causes {{el|Holy}} to deal double damage and inflict {{st|Burn|#=2}}.
** {{+}} Holy deals triple damage and inflicts 3 Burn.
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Using a spell with Holy adds an increasing amount of {{Icon|Heal|self-heal}} to the unit's basic attack.
* {{p|Evil Patron|+}}: Causes Holy to deal double damage.
* {{i|Spear of Destiny}}: Holy refreshes use.
* {{i|Steven (Neck Armor 1)}}: reduces the {{icon|Mana Cost}} of holy element spells by 1.

== Explosion ==
[[File:Element Explosion Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
{{el|Explosion}} has no effect on its own.

=== Notes ===
Of the 16 {{el|Explosion}} abilities in the game, 4 are {{class|Tinkerer}} abilities, 2 are {{class|Collarless}}, 2 are {{class|Druid}}, 2 are {{class|Psychic}}, and the remaining 6 belong to {{class|Hunter}}, {{class|Mage}}, {{class|Tank}}, {{class|Fighter}}, {{class|Butcher}}, and {{class|Monk}}.
* {{cl|Necromancer|Necromancer's}} {{a|Death Bloom}} also deals Explosion, but it is not shown in game.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Explosion element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Explosion element items]]
=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Mr. Mega}}: Increases explosion damage and area by 1.
** {{+}} Immunity, increases damage by 2.
* {{p|Napalm}}: Explosions inflict {{st|Burn|#=1}} and convert all tiles in the radius into {{tile|Fire|Fire Tiles}}.
* {{p|EMP}}: Increases explosion damage by 1, grants explosions {{el|Electric}} and an X% chance to {{st|Stun|stun}}, and prevents explosions from applying knockback.
** {{+}} Allies are immune to the cat's explosions.
* {{i|Top Hat}}: Increases explosion area by 1.
* {{i|Rad Glasses}}: Increases explosion damage and area by 1.
* {{i|Steven (Head Armor 1)}}: Grants immunity to {{el|Explosion}}, increases explosion area by 7 and damage by 2.
==== Other ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: No interaction.
{{Clear}}

== Gravity ==
[[File:Element Gravity Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
* {{el|Gravity}} inflicts {{st|Immobile}} on {{st|Flying}} units.
* Cuts down Tall {{tile|Tall Grass|Grass}} / {{tile|Tall Flower|Flower}} tiles into their short version.

=== Notes ===
Of the 16 {{el|Gravity}} abilities in the game, 13 are {{class|Psychic}} abilities, 2 are {{class|Fighter}}, and 1 is a {{class|Mage}} ability.

=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Gravity element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Gravity element items]]
=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Antigravity}}: reduces the {{icon|Mana Cost}} of gravity element spells by 1.
** {{+}} Reduces {{icon|Mana Cost}} by 2.
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: Grants the cat's basic attack {{st|Weakness|#=+1}}.
* {{p|Flourish}}: Gravity element abilities do not harm allies and apply a random positive status effect instead.
* {{p|Reality Shatter}}: Causes gravity to spawn {{tile|Floating Glass|floating glass tiles}}.
** {{+}} Gravity inflicts {{st|Bleed|#=1}}
* {{p|Wither}}: Gravity applies a random negative status effect to enemies.

{{Clear}}

== Music ==
[[File:Element Music Icon.svg|right|border|80px]]

=== Effects ===
{{el|Music}} has no effect on its own.

=== Notes ===
Of the 33 {{el|Music}} abilities in the game, 22 are {{class|Druid}} abilities, 3 are {{class|Collarless}}, 2 are {{class|Tank}}, 2 are {{class|Necromancer}}, and the remaining 4 belong to {{class|Cleric}}, {{class|Butcher}}, {{class|Monk}}, and {{class|Jester}}.

* {{el|Music}} is internally ''not'' an element, but a tag.
=== Sources ===
* [[:Category:Music element abilities]]
* [[:Category:Music element items]]
=== Interactions ===
==== Positive ====
* {{p|Encore}}: Refreshes basic attack when casting a {{el|music}} spell.
** {{+}} Reduces {{icon|Mana Cost}} of musical spells by 1.
* {{p|Maestro}}: Reduces {{icon|Mana Cost}} of musical spells by 50% rounded down.
** {{+}} {{icon|Heal|#=1}} and gain 1 random stat up when casting a musical spell.
* {{i|Steven (Face Armor 1)}}: Double casts musical spells.

==== Negative ====
* Unable to be cast by cats with {{mut|Mouth.-2|noimage=y}} or {{mut|Mouth.328}}.

==== Other ====
* {{p|Elemental Attunement}}: No interaction.

{{Clear}}

==Trivia==
* A hidden [[Types|enemy type]] known as “elementals” is listed for a few minibosses, implying that they may have been intended to embody one of these elements. 
** {{mb|Flushmaster}} represents the {{el|Water}} element.
